# Vendored libraries

- `crystal-battle`: <https://github.com/LinusU/pokemon-crystal-battle-engine>, commit `ba9cb13b4ba5d5d1080063ab471b7cec1ac781a6` (Crystal Legacy's game data, behind the `crystal-legacy` feature that `native/` enables), the `crates/crystal-battle` library without its tests. Local changes add serde serialization derives, add an interactive move-learning decision, and retain a full-party capture in the result (as a seventh result entry for the caller to send to storage). Astra also exposes the active move-learning slot and applies trainer catch-up experience to eligible fighters through the native level-up pipeline, reports the recipient and progress of each experience award, and limits capture items to wild battles. The battle and move-summary screens share the native Hidden Power calculation. Fixed guardian encounters can disable spontaneous wild flight while retaining battle moves and the player’s Run command. Normal wild battles use the original experience rules. The upstream checkout did not include a license file; its licensing should be confirmed before redistribution.
- `pokemon-synthesizer` 0.2.3: <https://github.com/LinusU/pokemon-synthesizer>, commit `66a0e01aa7d0554552a82f486b135af97f6c69ba`; upstream manifest declares MIT OR Apache-2.0. The upstream checkout did not include license text.
- `pokemon-sprite-compression` 0.1.2: <https://crates.io/crates/pokemon-sprite-compression/0.1.2>; upstream manifest declares MIT OR Apache-2.0. No ROMs or test fixtures are included.

The battle upstream still contains explicitly unported paths, including PP Up and contest-only mechanics. These are not covered by the smoke checks.
